gates.acceptance: Replay the three unchanged standard-library source programs; preserve failures and compare generated JSON except timing
requirements: Fresh environment; temporary source copies; raw stdout/stderr and exit/resource receipts

gates.acceptance: Definition-first enumeration agrees with exact counts; every feasible detailed prefix and rank is checked, including degeneracies
requirements: No source counting or Gaussian code in the reference
Exact rational implied probabilities and coupling marginals
Detect injected total, prefix and collision faults

gates.acceptance: Measure bounded source, brute-force and rejection runs on common inputs with setup charged and explicit skips
requirements: Wall, user+system CPU, peak RSS, matrix and serialized input sizes
Preserve limits/failures; do not infer asymptotics from timings

gates.acceptance: State supplied representation, ideal randomness, diagonal mass and remaining proof/acquisition/novelty boundaries
requirements: Consequential next experiment with explicit falsifier

gates.acceptance: Independent expert or formal reconstruction verifies the imported premise, all universal steps and the code-level refinement
requirements: Not closed by finite tests or this producer-operated reconstruction

gates.acceptance: Systematic primary-source and priority review of the exact corollary and sampler

registration_scope: Local exposed development gates; reused evaluation/templates/PROOF_GATES.json shape, not registered as an unseen research trial
